description: Run a comprehensive, parallel 3-pillar pre-launch audit on a production domain — combining brand/trademark conflict screening, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/DNSBL email deliverability verification, and AI search (`robots.txt`, `/llms.txt`, Schema.org JSON-LD) readiness into one unified 0-100 Launch Scorecard and prioritized remediation checklist. Reach for this tool when preparing a domain for launch or diagnosing overall technical growth readiness; use the specialized single-pillar tools when iterating on just one area.
